hypothesis: Replacing PyTorch exact-erf GELU with the directly measured LibNC unfused F32 tanh-GELU backward contract reduces every bound miniature first-update parameter error below 2e-5.
interfaces_exposed: Measured LibNC tanh-GELU backward -> bound miniature online update
kill_condition: Retire tanh-GELU as the sufficient parity fix if any final parameter remains above 2e-5; record which paths improve and continue only with a newly localized primitive, never a mature trace.
promotion_condition: Authorize the next frozen LibNC primitive-localization or full-profile ROCm parity gate only if initial distribution parity remains within 2e-5 and every final named parameter is within 2e-5 after the one bound update.
rejection_reason: Clean one-change rejection: measured tanh GELU improved frozen distribution parity to 4.657e-9 and output-layer update errors to about 2.8e-7, but internal parameters still reached 3.2e-4 versus the frozen 2e-5 gate. Repeated final tensor hashes were identical.
retired_neighborhoods: Exact-erf PyTorch GELU in NNCP online-update reproduction
title: NNCP v3.3 LibNC tanh-GELU online-update parity
